description: Comprehensive offscreen UI tests for all wizard pages and startup time measurement. Validates wizard behavior, routing logic, action triggers, and performance budgets using pytest-qt and QTest.
steps: Add test_install_wizard_routing_appimage_in_folder to tests/wizards/test_install_wizard.py: create AppImage file in applications_dir, instantiate InstallWizard, assert wizard.result() == QDialog.Accepted without showing any widgets (routing skips UI), verify QProcess.startDetached was called with ['appimage', 'run', managed_name]

Add test_install_wizard_page1_ui to tests/wizards/test_install_wizard.py: create AppImage outside applications_dir, instantiate InstallWizard with qtbot, assert Page 1 visible, verify icon QLabel, name QLabel, Install button enabled, Just run button enabled, Cancel button enabled. Use qtbot.addWidget(wizard) and check wizard._stacked.currentIndex() == 0

Add test_install_wizard_install_action to tests/wizards/test_install_wizard.py: mock backend.install_async, click Install button via qtbot.mouseClick, assert backend.install_async called with correct path and options {source_action: 'copy', conflict: 'replace', silent: true}, assert wizard switches to Page 2 (progress page)

Add test_install_wizard_just_run to tests/wizards/test_install_wizard.py: mock QProcess.startDetached, click 'Just run' button, assert QProcess.startDetached called with correct command, assert wizard closes

Add test_install_wizard_dont_ask_again to tests/wizards/test_install_wizard.py: check 'Don't ask again' checkbox, click 'Just run', assert config['wizard']['run_without_asking'] contains entry with app_id and sha256, assert config saved to disk (check paths.config_file.read_text() contains new entry)

Add test_install_wizard_flatpak_file to tests/wizards/test_install_wizard.py: create .flatpakref file in tmp_path, instantiate InstallWizard, click Install, assert QProcess started with ['flatpak', 'install', '--user', path]

Add test_install_wizard_startup_time to tests/wizards/test_install_wizard.py: record time.perf_counter() before InstallWizard.__init__, record again after wizard.show() returns, assert elapsed < 0.5 (500ms budget from R23.1)

Add test_uninstall_wizard_system_package_refusal to tests/wizards/test_uninstall_wizard.py: create DetectionResult with kind='pacman-system', instantiate UninstallWizard, assert only refusal page shown (single page with Close button), assert Remove button not present

Add test_uninstall_wizard_appimage_removal to tests/wizards/test_uninstall_wizard.py: create DetectionResult with kind='appimage', mock backend.remove_async, instantiate UninstallWizard with qtbot, assert Page 1 confirm visible, click Remove button, assert backend.remove_async called with {file_action: 'trash', silent: true}, assert Page 2 progress shown

Add test_uninstall_wizard_flatpak_uninstall to tests/wizards/test_uninstall_wizard.py: create DetectionResult with kind='flatpak', mock QProcess, click Remove, assert QProcess started with ['flatpak', 'uninstall', '--user', '-y', app_id]

Add test_uninstall_wizard_pacman_user_with_restart_note to tests/wizards/test_uninstall_wizard.py: create DetectionResult with kind='pacman-user', mock QProcess, click Remove, assert QProcess started with ['pkg', 'remove', name], assert status label on Page 2 contains text '(applies after restart)' or 'restart'

Add test_uninstall_wizard_unknown_file to tests/wizards/test_uninstall_wizard.py: create DetectionResult with kind='unknown', instantiate UninstallWizard, assert explanation page shown with message 'not managed' and Close button only, assert Remove button not present

In all wizard tests, use qapp_session fixture from tests/conftest.py and qtbot fixture from pytest-qt. Create minimal Config and Paths via tmp_path fixture. Mock backend methods using unittest.mock.patch or unittest.mock.Mock.
acceptance_criteria: test_install_wizard_routing_appimage_in_folder passes and verifies direct execution without UI
test_install_wizard_page1_ui passes and verifies all Page 1 widgets present and enabled
test_install_wizard_install_action passes and verifies backend.install_async called with correct parameters
test_install_wizard_just_run passes and verifies QProcess.startDetached called
test_install_wizard_dont_ask_again passes and verifies config persistence
test_install_wizard_flatpak_file passes and verifies flatpak install command
test_uninstall_wizard_appimage_removal passes and verifies Remove call with trash option
test_uninstall_wizard_flatpak_uninstall passes and verifies flatpak uninstall command
test_uninstall_wizard_pacman_user_with_restart_note passes and verifies restart note displayed
test_uninstall_wizard_unknown_file passes and verifies explanation page shown
verification: Run pytest tests/wizards/ -v and confirm all tests pass
Run ./check and confirm zero failures and zero ruff warnings
